Image 1 is the four-key sheet to revise. Keep the same 2x2 equal-square-cell layout and TRUE TRANSPARENCY. Keep the three clods' projected sizes and outlines IDENTICAL to image 1 in all cells. Their appearance is now correct: do not resize them, inflate them, soften their facets, rotate them, change highlights or redesign them.
The problem is insufficient vertical travel. Redraw each complete three-clod cluster at the following vertical placements. Coordinates below use a 627x627 virtual cell, matching the attached sheet's actual cell geometry. Keep the main clod center x=335 for left cells, x=335 for right cells in LOCAL coordinates, and keep the left/right small-clod horizontal arrangement from image 1.
TOP LEFT emergence: main clod center y=443 (about 65 pixels lower than the input top-left pose). Lower-left and lower-right clods move down coherently; all clods fully inside their cell, with no clipping.
TOP RIGHT rising: main clod center y=270 (about 20 pixels higher than input top-right). Same clod size, same facets.
BOTTOM LEFT apex: main clod center y=140 (about 85 pixels HIGHER than input bottom-left). The whole cluster rises together. Leave at least 20 pixels transparent above the highest clod.
BOTTOM RIGHT landing: main clod center y=443 (about 85 pixels lower than input bottom-right). Put the little clods low beside it while keeping their COMPLETE contours inside the square. This low key is later hidden by the fixed soil foreground, so draw full objects.
Keep the same three stable orange clod identities, front-facing view, warm upper-left light, fine dark brown contour and painted facets. Only 2-3 tiny crumbs consistently next to them. This is actual revised key artwork, no soil bed, no floor, no shadow, no labels, no grid, no background, no glow.
